category_title: Low-achieving students with disruptive behaviors and high absenteeism
scenario_title: Philosophical discussion on the concept of names
minimal_context: The student is participating in a whole-class philosophical discussion about whether people need to have names.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's start our discussion on the topic of 'name'. Does anybody have to have a name?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Yes, we have to have names. If not, we could not differentiate people and it will be difficult to call people... when we call hey! All who are present will answer...

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: That is one answer. Now please stay quiet and listen so we can hear from the rest of the class.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stands up from his seat) Why should I stay quiet? And this is confusing anyway! (Turns to the student next to him) Hey, what are you looking at, stupid?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please sit at your place and stop talking to your friends.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Engages in a loud verbal argument with his friend) Shut up! I don't have to sit down! (Walks away from his desk towards the door) I'm getting out of this class.
